movie.title: Dark Hollow
movie.overview: When a nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of an Appalachian coal mine, a young mother must hunt down the creature to protect her home and save her family.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When a terrifying monster emerges from an Appalachian coal mine, a fierce young mother must hunt it down to protect her family and home.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A quiet town in the Appalachian Mountains is thrust into terror when an ancient creature unleashes horror from deep within a local coal mine. As the beast threatens everything in its path, a desperate young mother realizes the authorities are ill-equipped to handle the threat. Driven by fierce maternal instinct, she armors up and sets out to hunt down the nightmare before it tears her family apart. Her fight becomes a battle for both her family's survival and the future of her community.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Deep within the heart of an Appalachian coal mining town, an unsettling discovery unleashes a deadly nightmarish monster from the forgotten depths of the Earth. As the creature begins terrorizing the local population, chaos swiftly consumes the isolated mountain region. Amidst the rising body count, a young mother realizes that her home and family are directly in the creature's path of destruction. With local law enforcement overwhelmed and scrambling for answers, she takes matters into her own hands to protect those she loves most. Equipping herself with local knowledge and sheer determination, she tracks the mysterious beast across treacherous rural terrain and subterranean caverns. Along the way, she uncovers disturbing truths about what brought the entity into the light and why it is hunting. Pushed to her absolute physical and emotional limits, she confronts the creature in a desperate, high-stakes battle for survival. Her relentless pursuit becomes a pulse-pounding stand against an unimaginable alien threat, proving how far a mother will go to shield her home.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Set against the rugged and atmospheric backdrop of rural Appalachia, Dark Hollow tells the suspenseful story of a close-knit community confronted by an terrifying, inhuman threat. When routine excavation work in a deep coal mine accidentally releases an aggressive, subterranean creature, the nearby town is plunged into a fight for survival. At the center of the storm is a young mother who must find extraordinary courage within herself when the beast targets her sanctuary. Blending visceral creature-feature action with grounded human drama, the narrative explores themes of maternal protection, resilience, and the unforeseen dangers buried beneath the surface of the earth. Dark Hollow delivers an action-packed, suspense-filled ride as one woman stands up to the dark unknown to keep her family safe.

story_structure.climax: A high-stakes, direct confrontation erupts between the mother and the creature in a desperate bid to end the threat once and for all.
story_structure.conflict: The town's quiet existence is shattered when an ancient, nightmarish monster emerges from the depths of the local coal mine, directly threatening the mother's home and loved ones.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the harrowing ordeal, the mother deals with the impact on her home and family as the town begins to recover from the nightmare.
story_structure.introduction: In a close-knit Appalachian coal-mining town, a young mother balances the everyday struggles of family life against the looming, oppressive backdrop of the surrounding mountains and deep mines.
story_structure.risingAction: As tensions rise and the creature's menace grows, the mother takes matters into her own hands, gathering resources, tracking the beast across dangerous terrain, and confronting her deepest fears to keep her family safe.
